name: ALL THREES
description: All Threes is a classic 'point-scoring' domino game from the Muggins family. While the more common 'All Fives' focuses on multiples of five, All Threes requires players to calculate multiples of three to score. It is a game of quick mental arithmetic and positional blocking.

content.text: All Threes is a classic 'point-scoring' domino game from the Muggins family. While the more common 'All Fives' focuses on multiples of five, All Threes requires players to calculate multiples of three to score. It is a game of quick mental arithmetic and positional blocking.

Part of the European layout games that emerged in the 18th and 19th centuries. It is the direct sibling to All Fives and the combined game 'Fives and Threes', which is a staple of British pub culture.
2 (7 tiles each), 3 (5 tiles each), or 4 (5 tiles each).
Domino tiles, cribbage board or score sheet.
Tiles are 'shuffled' face down (the 'wash'). Players draw their hand; remainders go to the 'Boneyard'.

items.text: Fives and Threes: The combined British favorite. Points are scored for multiples of 3 AND multiples of 5.
Block All Threes: No boneyard drawing. If you can't play, you simply pass.
